intro: Technology, government, and critical infrastructure sectors were the primary targets of zero-day exploitation between April 12 and May 4, 2026, according to 29 articles. Threat actors APT29, Chaotic Eclipse, and Claude Mythos were observed leveraging vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-22679 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-34621 (CVSS 8.6), CVE-2026-3502 (CVSS 7.8), CVE-2026-32183 (CVSS 7.5), and CVE-2026-32201 (CVSS 6.5). The coverage spanned 13 critical, 15 high, and 1 medium severity issues, with global impact extending across Asia, China, and Southeast Asia.
